title: Electuary or emulsion
html_source:
e·lec·tu·ar·y
noun archaic
a medicinal substance mixed with honey or another sweet substance.

e·mul·sion
noun
a fine dispersion of minute droplets of one liquid in another in which it is not soluble or miscible.
